results.title: Crumb
results.overview: Alyoshin is a pupil at a correctional orphanage. To confirm his legal capacity and to get out, he goes on an internship in a bakery. There, he falls in love with a co-worker and pretends that they are having an affair.

results.title: Judas Priest Live at Hellfest 2025
results.overview: One of the (eternal) most eagerly awaited returns to Hellfest 2025. Half a century into their metal career, Judas Priest deliver an epic concert, all riffs, pyrotechnics and studded biker leather.

results.title: ΝΙΚΗ (or The Impossible Hope of Trying)
results.overview: On the eve of the biggest show of her career, a young pop singer struggles with her sense of control over her art and her mind. But fate has other plans for her.

results.title: Before Your Father Finds Us
results.overview: Sophia and baby daughter, Emily, are forced to go into witness protection after she has to testify against her ex-husband Mason for his crimes. After years of living a seemingly normal life with new friends and relationships, Sophia learns that Mason has escaped from his maximum security prison. Knowing his strength and connections, Sophia is forced to reveal the truth to her now teenage daughter about who her father really is – and having to leave everything behind. Escaping to an old remote cabin in the woods together, Sophia and Emily must do everything it takes to survive Mason and his ruthless intent to make the family whole again.

results.title: Nekomata Okayu 2nd Live. "PERSONYA RESPECT"
results.original_title: 猫又おかゆ 2nd Live.「ぺるそにゃ～りすぺくと」
results.overview: Nekomata Okayu's second solo live concert, performed at Pia Arena MM 28.05.2025. Featuring special guests Shirakami Fubuki, Ookami Mio and Inugami Korone.

results.title: And I Would Be Beautiful
results.overview: My boobs? They're too small, even Fanny said so. My butt? I hate it! My face? In a trash can… Thanks to Muse, I could become someone else. In just 30 days, I'd have slimmer legs, higher breasts and a firmer bottom. And finally, I would be beautiful.

results.title: Guardians of the Galapagos
results.overview: Go behind the scenes with the crew of Sea Lions of the Galapagos to showcase not just the production of a film, but the world that inspired it.

results.title: Lost in Mekong
results.original_title: หลง-ลืม-ระหว่างโขง
results.overview: After his father disappears in the Mekong River, Tawan, a devout atheist, must lead the search. While villagers demand he perform a sacred ritual to appease the mythical  Naga.

results.title: Something's More Than One Thing
results.overview: To save their relationship, a young couple dive down a rabbit hole of conflicting internet advice.

results.title: Queen of Manhattan
results.overview: Follows the wild, exhilarating life of legendary adult film icon Vanessa Del Rio, set against the backdrop of organized crime-controlled Times Square during the 70s and 80s.

results.title: Crossroad
results.overview: A former boxer who quit the ring after a family tragedy forbids his gifted son from fighting. The son secretly competes and wins, forcing father and son to confront grief and finally reconcile.

results.title: Solata [Teman Adalah Keluarga yang Kita Pilih]
results.original_title: Solata [Teman Adalah Keluarga yang Kita Pilih]
results.overview: Angkasa, a volunteer from Jakarta who is a teacher in the Remote Class in the interior of Toraja. There, he met six students with unique names that were similar to the names of the Presidents of the Republic of Indonesia.

results.title: The Legend of Kingdom Come
results.overview: This feature documentary is an origin story about the beloved 90s-era graphic novel Kingdom Come, going behind the scenes and inside the mind of its creator: comic book legend Alex Ross.

results.title: Ces traditions qui nous enchainent
results.overview: In the 80s, Jamel is a young musician who lives in Marseille. While he is seeing young Barbara, his mother tells him of the imminent arrival of his uncle Houcine and his cousin Nadia, to whom he would be promised since birth by tradition.

results.title: Graduation Day
results.overview: "Graduation Day" is an edgy coming-of-age dramedy following high school senior Cheech as he navigates his identity, a love triangle with his best friend Sparkes, longtime crush Jayla, and the bittersweet chaos of growing up in NYC-all while rocking a red sparkly suit and surviving a party bus ride that takes his big day in some unexpected directions.

results.title: Hamleys: Top 100 Toys of All Time
results.original_title: Hamleys: Top 100 Toys of All Time
results.overview: Hamleys throws open its doors for a celeb-packed celebration of the toys that defined generations. From timeless classics to modern icons, we explore the biggest toy crazes of the last 200 years.

results.title: Barselo
results.overview: At the surface, the city’s massive central bus terminal hums with the familiar chaos of noise, movement, and crowds. But as night falls, a darker, hidden world begins to stir beneath.Two veteran bus drivers guide a young attendant through his “first experience” — taking him to a clandestine brothel tucked away in the terminal’s underground levels. What begins as a seemingly ordinary night of pleasure slowly unravels into a gripping chain of events.

results.title: JAPA
results.overview: Two young lovers, Emeka and Fola, who dream of leaving Nigeria for a better life abroad. Their parents have warned them not to share their plans with anyone, including each other, for spiritual reasons. Both keep their intentions hidden.

results.title: Intravenus
results.overview: A young woman is trapped in a bizarre medical university that's run by a deranged eugenicist. With no memory of how or why she was even enrolled, her attempts to seek answers instead unearths a disturbed secret that is practically hidden in plain sight.
